project_type: Next.js 16 App Router (Turbopack) with TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: npm scripts (next build). Prisma generate runs as postinstall. Node 22 at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin. PATH must include that and node_modules/.bin.
test_framework: vitest with src/**/*.test.ts pattern. Tests use vi.mock() for Prisma/OpenAI/guarded-llm.
build_command: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:/projects/sandbox/career-toolkit/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run lint (must pass). 2. Run npm run build (must compile). 3. Run npx vitest run (all tests pass).
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ is generated by prisma generate (runs on postinstall). After schema changes, run: npx prisma generate
setup_instructions: PATH setup as above. node_modules already installed. For schema changes: npx prisma generate to update client types.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. PostgreSQL via Neon (cannot run prisma db push without DB connection - use prisma generate for type checking). No npm global install needed since node_modules exists.
contribution_requirements: npm run lint && npm run build must both pass. All API routes must have try/catch with error messages in response body.
key_patterns: API routes in src/app/api/ use NextRequest/NextResponse. Error handling via formatErrorResponse/validationError from src/lib/api-error.ts. Prisma singleton from src/lib/db.ts (import { prisma }). LLM calls via guardedLLMCall from src/lib/guarded-llm.ts. Tests mock prisma, openai, and guarded-llm via vi.mock(). UI pages are 'use client' React components with fetch to API routes.
directory_structure: src/app/ = Next.js App Router pages and API routes. src/lib/ = business logic. src/lib/__tests__/ = vitest tests. src/lib/generation/ = pipeline stages. src/lib/prompts/ = prompt templates. src/components/ = shared UI components. prisma/ = schema and migrations. scripts/ = one-time scripts.
